text:
jordan: Hey team — ACME wants a short POC (2 weeks) next month. They need:
- dedicated pool for latency-sensitive inference
- Private/VPC option for data flow tests
- Billing project with a hard spend guard (they suggested $3,000) and $5k free credits to apply first
Can we provision hosted ephemeral API keys for devs, spin a small dedicated pool, and set the billing/quota rules? Start date target: Mon Apr 12. Who can own infra + billing setup?

maya: I can own infra provisioning. Need customer org name, expected QPS, and GPU preference. For a temporary dedicated pool we can do a small reserved slot (e.g. 2xA100) for the POC, or a single larger GPU if they accept lower throughput. Also need a teardown date to auto-deprovision.

tess: FYI ACME expects ~50 qps peak and ~100k tokens/day during tests. They've asked that free credits apply first, then spend cap at $3k. They want per-route cost visibility and token-level breakdown in Console.

sam_fin: Quick finance note — we can create a billing project and set a quota equivalent to $3k to act as a spend cap (hosted API). Quotas are enforced on usage units rather than currency; I'll convert token estimates to quota units. For Dedicated, billing is commit-based — we can offer a short-term reserved slot and invoice for the commit. If they want net-30 invoicing instead of card, Sales needs to approve the terms.

jordan: Great. Two questions from the customer: (1) can each dev get ephemeral keys that rotate, (2) can we pause or deprovision the dedicated pool after POC to avoid further charges?

maya: (1) Yes — ephemeral keys supported. Example CLI to create dev ephemerals:
```
ephemerald create --org acme-poc --users jane,li,omar --ttl 14d
```
They expire automatically; we can also wire SCIM/SAML for SSO. (2) Yes — we can schedule auto-deprovision on the tear-down date. For VPC peering we need customer's CIDR ranges and BGP/ASN if they want routed peering.

tess: Security flagged KMS integration and SOC2/ISO attestations. I'll send ACME our security pack and the POC checklist link: http://redwood.internal/poc-checklist (contains network, KMS, data handling).

jordan: They also asked whether Dedicated can be scaled down mid-POC if load is lower.

maya: We can scale capacity but Dedicated commit pricing applies to reserved slots. For POC I recommend 2xA100 with quantized 70B model to keep costs reasonable. If they need full perf for benchmarks, note that 70B at full perf prefers 8xA100.

deploy-bot: Billing project `acme-poc-billing` created (id: bp-8923). Ephemeral keys provisioned for 6 users (ttl 14d). Quota applied: 3000 USD-equivalent.

sam_fin: Recorded: billing contact invoices@acme.com, payment method currently card-on-file. If they want invoice terms (NET-30) send request to sales-ops. Free credits ($5k) will be consumed prior to quota.

jordan: @maya can you confirm ETA to stand up the 2xA100 dedicated pool once we have approval? I’ll confirm CIDR and payment preference today.

maya: ETA ~48h after approval and capacity allocation. I will open the infra change ticket and tag @tess for SOW dates.

tess: I'll draft the SOW today with POC dates, billing treatment, and teardown action. Will also capture net-30 request if they ask.

jordan: Awesome — Thanks all :thumbsup:
